messages.subject: shinyapps.io GitHub login failed
parts:
I am trying to log into shinyapps.io using GitHub and am getting a "login failed" message after entering my username and password correctly. I see another user with this error that was never resolved (publicly). When I attempt to log in, I can see shinyapps listed in my Authorized OAuth Apps page on GitHub, but subsequent login attempts on shinyapps go directly to the "login failed" screen, without asking for login credentials again. I can revoke the authorization from within GitHub and try again, but the same thing happens.

Ideas?
Thanks.
Jens
